findings.text: The declared base arm is not a base arm. Its header claims tree /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261107T150107307022-openai-model-refresh-code/base-release at revision 566ee7678, but line 8 reports '6 workers [9622 items]' — the item count of the reviewed worktree, which I measured at 9622 — while that base tree is missing tests/discovery/test_decisions_release_tracking.py (9 tests) and the new settings guard (1), so it can collect at most 9612. The base tree also cannot import the package at all (ModuleNotFoundError: imas_codex.graph.models, generated models absent), so the run that produced this log did not import the base tree either. The 4-failed/2-failed delta the manifest cites therefore compares two runs of the same code, and the node's central no-regression claim is unsupported.

_judge_cost_sink reserves exactly the reported spend through BudgetManager.reserve, which raises ValueError('reserved provider exposure must be finite and positive') for amount <= 0 while imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3535 admits a zero usage.cost, so a successful zero-cost decisions response now aborts the enrich review stage through _settle_call; and when the pool is short the same call returns None at line 549 and the LLMCost row for a call the provider already billed is dropped silently, which is the loss this change exists to end. Guard the zero and record the spend the way charge_event's overspend path already does.

Nothing in tests/ references _judge_cost_sink: reverting line 637's PipelineCost(charge=_judge_cost_sink(state)) to PipelineCost() leaves every test green, so the one wiring that actually persists a review-stage call is unguarded, as is worker_review_docs.py:554's model_release stamp.

openrouter-pricing entries for gpt-5.6-luna (:904), gpt-5.5 (:952) and gpt-5.4 (:963) remain, so the done-when's 'pyproject.toml references no OpenAI model older than the newest of its tier' is literally unmet; they are still referenced only by test fixtures, and the new guard in tests/core/test_settings.py:607 asserts the bench slate and the route table but never the pricing section, so a stale pricing row would not redden it.

The tests: line and both baseline_suite/after_suite command values (lines 16-17) carry <tree>, <base-release> and <worktree> placeholders instead of the literal commands, so neither can be re-run as a gate receipt; the manifest contract requires the literal text a shell was handed.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_decisions_release_tracking.py:894 and :127 fail if judgment._book_cost stops calling record_llm_call, but no test binds imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py:637's _judge_cost_sink or worker_review_docs.py:554's release stamp, so reverting either production wiring leaves every test green.
justifications.evidence: gate-durable-base.log:8 reads '6 workers [9622 items]' while the base-release tree it names lacks tests/discovery/test_decisions_release_tracking.py and tests/core/test_settings.py's new guard, which collect 9622 only in the reviewed worktree, so the recorded 'base arm' collected the after tree's tests.
justifications.fit: The optional record_release sink at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3625 keeps the two-value return and the module's docstring-per-argument idiom, and no changed path or symbol carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/settings.py:1973-1999 and imas_codex/config/litellm_config.yaml:88-104 carry the newest model of each OpenAI tier, but pyproject.toml:904, :952 and :963 still reference gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.4.
justifications.reuse: PipelineCost.record_llm_call at imas_codex/ids/mapping.py:114 extends the tracker the decisions path already books into and hands persistence to record_llm_cost at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:34, the repository's LLMCost writer, though the reserve-then-charge_event idiom is restated at imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py:548 rather than shared with imas_codex/standard_names/review/cascade.py:674.
justifications.scope_discipline: Four changed paths (imas_codex/standard_names/budget.py, graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py, review/pipeline.py, worker_tasks/worker_review_docs.py) fall outside the eleven write paths the manifest declares, although the manifest records the instruction that resolved to them.

outside_scope: The run's own note that imas_codex/llm/prompts/sn/generate_name_system.md was truncated to zero bytes during a standard-names gate run is a test-side defect outside this diff and is restored at HEAD; it is not reviewed here.
